messages:
Maria (Marketing): Hey team — quick sync on the NimbusAI customer spotlight. They're confirmed for a 30-min interview next Wed (UTC-friendly). Need checklist: final quote, legal sign-off on any metrics, logo/headshot, 1–2 dashboard screenshots, and a lightweight press kit so Sales can route inbound leads after publish. Who wants to own the assets + scheduling?
Clara (Customer Success): I got this — I can coordinate assets and own the recording. Will set up a Zoom, record, and push transcript to the drive. Planning to ask for a short (2–3 sentence) customer quote live. :+1:
Tony (Sales): Thanks Clara. For routing, can we add a demo request CTA and tag leads as "case-study-inbound" so AE team can follow up? Also want a short one-pager playbook for deals influenced by this case study.
Jason (Product): Suggested metric phrasing that Nimbus mentioned in the briefing call — feel free to edit before legal sees it: 
```
"With Redwood we saw 3x lower generation latency at 25% lower per-token cost in our peak workloads, enabling faster user flows and cheaper scaling." 
```
Also can include a screenshot of the experiment dashboard (I'll grab it).
Elaine (Legal): Heads-up — customer approved a narrative, but they asked that any precise cost numbers be accompanied by the test context (model, batch sizes, quantization). I can review the exact quote, but prefer we use relative phrasing + an attribution line. If you post the quote as-is, please add: "– NimbusAI, Engineering" as attribution and cc me for final sign-off.
Maria (Marketing): Good call. Clara — when you ask for the quote live, please record the exact wording and ask if they want the engineering attribution. I'll draft the press kit + blog and share for review by Monday so we can get legal sign-off before publish.
Clara (Customer Success): Calendar invite set: Wed 14:00 UTC -> 1891234567-zoom. Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NIMBUS-CASEKIT (will populate assets there).
Tony (Sales): For lead routing: can we have a lightweight landing form that sets utm=case_nimbus and auto-labels SFDC leads with "case_study: NimbusAI"? If dev + growth teams can support, we can pipe leads to the right queue.
Jason (Product): I'll export the dashboard screenshots to the drive and add a short explainer for the blog (what we measured, methodology bullet list).
Elaine (Legal): I'll aim to get the quote and any redlines back by end of Tuesday. If you can share the draft quote in the doc, I can inline comments. Also remind Nimbus about privacy: do not include user PII or raw logs.
Maria (Marketing): Plan: I will draft the blog + social blurbs + email snippet by Mon EOD, share in this thread for comments. Publishing target = next Thu. Webinar tie-in idea: short 20-min webinar with Nimbus + Product in two weeks — would be good to coordinate but separate thread.
Clara (Customer Success): After interview I'll upload the transcript and pull 3 potential short pull-quotes for marketing. Will also ask for logo file (SVG) and headshot.
Tony (Sales): Once live, can we run a two-week cadence where AE team follows up on case-driven signups? I'll create a simple playbook and drop in the drive.
Maria (Marketing): Awesome — thanks all. Action items: Clara = schedule + assets + transcript; Jason = screenshots + experiment context; Tony = lead routing spec + playbook; Elaine = legal review by Tue EOD; Maria = draft + publish plan. Ping me if anything slips. :rocket:
Elaine (Legal): Confirming I got it — will review doc at 17:00 UTC Tue and leave redlines.
Clara (Customer Success): Small note for the interview: ask them to keep the quote <40 words so it fits the hero section.
Maria (Marketing): Noted. I'll format the hero to accept a short quote then a longer blockquote below.
Tony (Sales): :thumbsup: good timeline.
Maria (Marketing): Closing loop — posting draft later today to the shared doc and tagging everyone for review. Thanks!
